name: Asian Paints Ltd

business.about: Asian Paints is the largest home decor company in India. The 80+yr old company has major brands like Asian Paints, Apco, etc under its umbrella. The co. is into wall paints, wall coverings, waterproofing, texture painting, wall stickers, mechanized tools, adhesives, modular kitchens, sanitaryware, lightings, soft furnishings, and uPVC windows.

calls.tone: Management expressed confidence in H1 performance and future outlook, despite Q2 inflationary pressures.
pushback: Impact of inventory on Q2 volumes and normalization in October.
Outlook for gross margin in H2, given price hikes and product mix.

delivery_comments.quote: overall volumes despite a very high inflationary environment and the steep price hikes... we have been able to grow at a good volume of about 6.4%
the value growth has also been very strong at 14.5%.
From a point of view of H1, the picture is even far brighter, given the top line is closer to about 16%, given the run in quarter one of what we had.
The great thing to look at is that the PBDIT margin growth at a half-year level is very good and the PBDIT margin is in the higher range of the overall band of what we have been speaking at 19.6%.

delivery_comments.quote: The PBT margins have been a little bit stressed here, about 15.7%, lower by 119 bps.

the overall gross margin trend has also been fairly strong. There was some pressure on gross margin; we were at about 45.6% in the last quarter. However, we are still higher if you look at it on a YoY basis.

delivery_comments.topic: Consolidated top line and PBDIT margins
delivery_comments.quote: Consolidated financials almost follow the same route. In fact, it improved to about an 18% top line growth. ... PBDIT margins stand at about 20.6%, almost 240 bps higher YoY.
We seem to be quite happy of what we had predicted last quarter, that we should be in that band of about 8% to 10%.

delivery_comments.topic: Q3 festive season and monsoon impact
delivery_comments.quote: therefore we got only about 15 odd days in October which was festive. We also had a prolonged monsoon which stepped into October as well. So, it was not great.
overall, November and December, were good, which helped us basically prop the entire Q3 volume to about 7.9% growth.
Net Sales growth is about 2.9%, I think a little bit lower here because of the festive season being cut short.
So, again possibly, strong catch up in Q3 and therefore that is reflecting in the 9M in terms of how we see overall results.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management pledged 18‑20% EBITDA margin for FY27 (G1,G9,G22)
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Q1 FY27 21% and Q2 FY27 16% EBITDA margin

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Volume growth of 8‑10% for FY27 was promised (G8)

narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Gross margin was about 45.6% in Q1 FY27

bull.point: EBITDA margin hit 21% in Q1 FY27, above guidance
H1 FY27 top‑line growth ~16% beats prior expectations

bear.point: Volume growth 6.4% falls short of 8‑10% promise
Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 16% undercuts lower bound of 18%
Capacity expansion to 150 KT not yet realized

verdict: Management largely missed volume and margin consistency targets, though gross margin and Q1 EBITDA exceeded expectations.
